detail.title: Reactivating Divergence Research
detail.summary: Reactivated the Divergence in Value Formation project and defined a new hypothesis to test whether stochasticity in exploration, rather than purely reward scalarization, drives value divergence in identical environments.

detail.title: Divergence in Value Formation
detail.question: Do autonomous agents with identical initial conditions and exposure to identical environments develop divergent value systems?
detail.reason: Attention rotation requires clearing active slots to prioritize responsibility_formation.
